limitations: Verified complete official archive no-trade intervals cannot fill orders; unknown gaps freeze exposure. OHLC cannot prove post-only queue fills, spread, partial fills or intrabar order sequence. Stop-limit exits may remain unfilled, and the +0.85% fee cushion cannot guarantee a filled exit. Data gaps freeze unresolved positions/reservations; affected performance cannot approve production. Monthly trade/profit targets are measured, not guaranteed. Marked equity includes open assets without future exit fees.

liquiditySelection.rankingMethod: Sum of completed daily close times base volume; EUR turnover proxy, not order-book depth
liquiditySelection.backtestSelection: Daily top 30 by previous completed UTC daily close times volume; no future listings or turnover used. This is a volume proxy; historical 24h VWAP/order-book depth is unavailable.
